title: sesleria caerulea subsp. angustifolia
intro: Sesleria caerulea subsp. angustifolia, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Blue Moor-grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Sesleria caerulea subsp. angustifolia include antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory activities, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Sesleria caerulea subsp. angustifolia for medicinal use.
